hazard_level: Low to Moderate (Moderate if containing a rechargeable lithium-ion battery)
hazards: Lead-based solder in older circuit boards
Brominated flame retardants (BFRs) in the plastic shell
Alkaline or lithium-ion batteries in wireless models
safe_handling: Remove any removable AA/AAA batteries before storage
Store in a dry e-waste bin
unsafe_actions: Do not crush or break the plastic housing
Do not burn cables or plastic shells
Do not dispose in regular municipal trash
what_to_do_if_damaged: If the casing is cracked, avoid sharp edges and place the mouse aside for authorised collection. If an internal battery is swollen, hot, or leaking, do not remove or handle it; keep people away and contact a qualified technician or emergency services as appropriate.
disposal_route: Segregate removable batteries for battery recycling and hand the mouse over to a CPCB/SPCB-authorized e-waste recycler or PRO collection center.
recoverable_materials: Trace gold and silver on circuit contacts
Steel and aluminum from scroll mechanisms
environmental_impact: Improper dumping causes microplastic pollution and leaches heavy metals and flame retardants into soil and groundwater; burning wires releases toxic dioxins.
